[[philosophy|Philosophically]], applying '''intuition''' means trusting that what seems "obviously true" to us, such as "2+2=4" is actually true.<ref>{{#cite:Q1837}}</ref>

<blockquote>
{{#content:Q3062}}
</blockquote>

== Limitations ==

The accuracy of human intuition is limited by human [[cognitive bias|cognitive biases]], which may be a result of applying [[heuristic]]s or [[naive empiricism]].
